parameters.name: NewDisplayName
parameters.description:
The display name of the resource group.

The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to obtain the ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager update-resource-group --resource-group-id rg-9gLOoK0000 --new-display-name project --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
